name: Verify artifact
description: Verify a SurStor artifact's integrity. Checks the Cell 2 branch-ref binding to Cell 1. With deep=true, walks the full session hash chain and recomputes costs against cited price schedules. Estimates from dated published rates and caller-supplied usage, not provider invoices. Unpriced records are excluded from totals. See docs/billing.md; return the warning to the user.

deep.description: Walk session chain and recompute costs

warning.description: Display this pricing and calculation warning to the user.
